claim: With current and recent observable input exactly matched, an older anonymous-lineage event remains recoverable from SparkBrain probe response at long lag beyond a conventional contractive fading-memory reservoir with equal observable input and equal linear-readout privilege.

remote_event.paired_intervention: swap which anonymous lineage receives the strong remote event

washout.generator: one base-world symmetric filler sequence reused by both paired interventions and suffix-nested across all lag conditions

task_world.recent_window_match: exactly identical across intervention pair and across all lag conditions within one base world
task_world.target: which anonymous lineage received the strong remote event; -1 for lineage 0, +1 for lineage 1
task_world.history_reset: fresh SparkBrain and fresh reservoir zero-state for every history

dev.use: fit exactly one fixed ridge readout per model; no hyperparameter selection

test.use: one-way formal evaluation only after future Analyst authorization

splits.leakage_rule: DEV and TEST base-world seeds and identifiers are disjoint; TEST targets never participate in fit, tune, select, thresholds, architecture, or runtime choice

candidate_observation_and_readout.input: the exact same ordered 2-vector observation sequence as the comparator
candidate_observation_and_readout.probe_feature: 64-vector; per v0.4 unit, sum potential_before_reset over spikes emitted during the final symmetric probe only
candidate_observation_and_readout.fit_budget: one fit on all DEV histories; zero tune/select retries

formal_comparator.probe_feature: 64-vector reservoir state immediately after the same final symmetric probe
formal_comparator.readout: the identical ridge-linear procedure and alpha used for SparkBrain
formal_comparator.fit_budget: one fit on all DEV histories; zero tune/select retries
formal_comparator.fading_memory_guarantee: every recurrent row has absolute weight sum 0.9 < 1 before tanh; with leak 0.35 this is a contractive finite-dimensional fading-memory state system

resource_matching.rule: reservoir state dimension equals SparkBrain v0.4 field unit count (8 x 8 = 64); both models expose exactly 64 probe features and receive the same 2-dimensional observations and same one-shot ridge readout privilege

primary_scoring.effect: SparkBrain accuracy minus reservoir accuracy over all TEST rows at lags 64 and 128
primary_scoring.cluster_unit: base_world_id; all lags and both paired interventions from a base world travel together with bootstrap multiplicity
primary_scoring.secondary_descriptive: per-lag accuracies at 16, 32, 64, 128; no secondary endpoint may override the primary terminal classification

integrity_order: future Analyst explicitly authorizes and reserves one fresh identity
create STARTED/no-clobber before any TEST read
materialize target-free TEST input inventory only
generate candidate and comparator TEST raw scores without TEST targets
write immutable raw plus inventory and binding manifest
independently refetch preserved raw and verify digests/cardinality
perform unique total fail-closed history_id join
score deterministically and append terminal evidence
invalid_evidence_if: TEST target accessed before immutable raw preservation and independent refetch
raw cardinality differs from 2048 model prediction rows or target cardinality differs from 1024 histories
post-START repair, rerun, retune, threshold change, comparator shopping, or outcome-responsive redefinition
